releaseNotes: ## [2.0.0] — Tester drop (2026-07-14)  ### Fixed (Wave 1 — app review 2026-07-13)  - Account switching now wipes the previous account's local data (calls, contacts, tags, notes, caches) before the new session appears; re-login by the same account keeps everything. - Restoring a backup now invalidates the cached Insights/Stats dashboards and recomputes immediately. - Inquiries and Follow-ups no longer sit on loading shimmer forever when a list is empty. - Converting an inquiry to a contact no longer leaks the auto-save prefix into the suggested name. - Junk caller names (email artifacts like ".name123@") now fall back to the phone number; avatars show a letter or digit, never punctuation. - Deleted calls are now excluded from all Stats charts, top-caller lists, tag counts and the Weekly digest. - Removed the dead "Update alerts" toggle (its update-checker was retired in May). - Calls tab shows a calm "No calls yet today" line instead of four zero-chips on quiet days; call-detail badge row aligned; Follow-ups info icon sits inline with its filters; More tab regained its title.  ### Added - Premium UX surfaces (paywall, gate screen, badges, My Plan) — `PremiumBadge`, `PremiumLock`, `UpsellSheet`, `TrialBanner`, and `LimitMeter` components; a `premium/paywall` pricing screen (1/6/12-month plan cards, feature list, footer legal links, restore purchase) with a clearly-labeled **test-purchase stub** standing in for Razorpay checkout; a `premium/my_plan` screen (plan status, payment history placeholder, WhatsApp support link); and a "callNest Premium" row on the More tab + a plan card on Account. - Premium gates are now wired everywhere the spec calls for them — a hard paywall gate when a plan expires, trial locks on Export/Quick export/Auto-tag rules/Weekly digest AI/Cloud backup/CSV import, a trial countdown banner on Calls, and a "38 of 50 trial saves" meter + honest "Save 12 of 18 (trial limit)" wording on Inquiries — but **everything stays fully off by default**: a new master switch (off) keeps every user on today's unlimited experience until it's explicitly turned on. A `BuildConfig.DEBUG`-only "Premium debug" row in Settings lets testers flip the switch and simulate Trial/Active/Expired states without a real purchase.  ### Fixed - Auto-save now sanitizes punctuated numbers (spaces/dashes/parens) before validity-checking and writing, so numbers like `"98765 43210"` no longer get silently skipped; "Save now" / "Save all now" / "Bulk save" bypass the per-SIM auto-save filter as explicit user overrides; and the Bulk save dialog now lists each unsaved number with its specific failure reason instead of a single aggregate count. - Restored the master "Auto-save unsaved numbers" toggle on the Auto-save settings screen (off by default) — the switch widget had been removed from the UI while its backing ViewModel/service wiring stayed intact, making the feature unreachable. Also fixed `CallEnrichmentService` self-stopping after the very first call when auto-save was the only real-time toggle enabled (bubble/popup off), which silently broke instant per-call auto-save for anyone using auto-save on its own.
